name: gushwork-design-site
description: gushwork-design.vercel.app — static pages plus the Google auth gate. No build step. Two dependencies, @vercel/blob and web-push, each imported lazily inside the output routes (api/_log-output.js, api/_usage-log.js) so a failure there cannot take the other routes down; they exist so Vercel treats api/*.js and middleware.js as ES modules.
